description: Nevada Secretary of State Commercial Recordings (SilverFlume) business entity bulk data (access review; paid, nothing confirmed) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/sources/nv-sos-entities.md.

sources.publisher: Nevada Secretary of State, Commercial Recordings Division
sources.gate: Two gates. (1) The publisher's edge network (Imperva/Incapsula) blocks the collector's user agent: nvsos.gov/robots.txt returned a bot-challenge page, so robots.txt and the terms could not be read. (2) Bulk data is a service of the Secretary of State's online services account system ('Bulk Data Download', listed on the SOS account login page, nvsosuat.nv.gov) that needs a registered account; no price was found on any readable official page. A person must create the account, read the price and terms, and decide whether to pay.
sources.license: Unknown; no license or terms read
sources.notes: What was found: the SOS online-services login page lists 'Bulk Data Download' as a service for customized reports of raw data from the corporations, UCC, voter registration and notary databases (test-domain copy of a public-records page). Vendor claims, unconfirmed and not relied on: Topograph says Nevada sells bulk data only on a paid subscription; a Global Database blog says a full corporations dump is $125 and unlimited reports $500 a month, and that SilverFlume was switched off on 2026-09-14 and replaced by 'ORION'. Neither could be checked against an official page. The free route is the interactive entity search. Nothing was purchased and no account was created.
